note: One entry per native destination. 'writes' lists native commands that change gameplay data; hybrid entries delegate to the web handlers named in 'delegatedInteractions' (CONTRACT A14-A15 gap, see MIGRATION.md).

readContract.ordering: webSessionId and increasing sequence; a new session may bind only through explicit open
readContract.invalidation: renderCharacterPage changes, host resume, foreground return, and 15-second refresh while visible
readContract.persistence: no native product writes, no durable revision or epoch inserted

features.rollout: Classic is default; Native Character preview is opt-in
features.mutationsGate: CONTRACT A14-A15; no native gameplay mutation endpoint is exposed

commands.preview: keeps the draft on the page so the next projection previews it; never replaces what is being typed (draftRevision unchanged)
commands.submit: recordActivity(draft + opId): one operation id pays out once; a failed save is taken back out and reported; on success the page toasts and goes to Overview

writes: recordActivity via submit (web-owned rules and save)

readContract.ordering: webSessionId and increasing sequence; draftRevision changes only when the page replaces the draft (save, prefill)

features.mutationsGate: operation id per draft (idempotent submit); no durable receipt across process death yet (A14/A15 gap)
features.rollout: opt-in under Settings, Appearance: Native Log activity (beta)

commands.toggle: planToggle(date, key, set, checked) with set semantics: the set ends as asked, a repeat answers changed:false and saves nothing; unknown sets, malformed dates and future days are refused; a failed save answers ok:false with the page's own message and, as after the page's checkbox, stays in memory with what the save set off (badges, the daily-hand quest) until the next save stores it; a completed day pays its XP once (actId); celebrateXP is held and returned as celebrations for the screen to draw, the page plays xpCue after the reply

writes: planToggle via toggle (web-owned rules and save)
delegatedInteractions: planLog (session log field on the page)
startPlan and the class offers (no plan: the page is not covered)

readContract.ordering: webSessionId and increasing sequence; selected.revision rises only when the page changes its selected day
readContract.invalidation: renderPlan, host resume, foreground return, 15-second refresh while visible; the page covering its view (body class and children, #planBody, plan fields) closes the screen and brings it back

features.mutationsGate: set semantics make a repeated toggle harmless; no durable receipt across process death (A14/A15 gap)
features.rollout: opt-in under Settings, Appearance: Native Workout plan (beta)

features.covers: only while LifeDirector.native.showing() is 'today': set up with a plan, Today on screen, no sheet open and no guide due or running; and not while the XP celebration of one of its taps plays on the page

commands.day: {index}: shows that day of the strip; read-only, refused when the day is not on the strip; the screen stays

delegatedInteractions: tab: Week, Goals, Quests, My time, Settings

readContract.invalidation: LifeDirector.native.onChange (a render, a sheet or the guide opening or closing, a message), host resume, foreground return, 15-second refresh while visible

features.mutationsGate: no native writes; Done and the timer run the page's own handlers after the screen closes, and the screen comes back once their XP celebration has played; a tap on a session or meal that has left the plan is told so
features.rollout: opt-in under Settings, Appearance: Native Life Director (beta), off by default

features.covers: the Media pane only, and not while the add/edit form is open, the audio player is loading, loaded or showing, a file button handed to the owner has the focus, a handed-back tap is running, or a level-up plays; the Journal stays on the page
delegatedInteractions: showMediaForm() and showMediaForm(item): add and edit, saved by saveMediaItem through mediaUpsert
toggleMediaFinished(id, true) for finished, toggleMediaFinished(id, false) for unfinished
pickAudioForMedia through the row's own file button, shown, focused and named in a toast on the page (no programmatic picker)
playMediaAudio(id) and the whole audio player
the row's link: an anchor like the row's, http and https only
the Journal: lmaNavTo('history'), a web destination behind its lock

readContract.fixtures: native/src/test/resources/fixtures/media-full.json, media-search.json, media-empty.json, media-tip.json, and media-filter-parity.json (the rows the page shows for sample filters of media-full) (lifemax_modular_v73/tools/gen_native_fixtures.js)
readContract.ordering: webSessionId and increasing sequence; filter.revision rises only when the page sets its filter (typed on the page, a voice search); notice.id counts the page's toasts
readContract.invalidation: renderMedia, a page toast, host resume, foreground return, 15-second refresh while visible; the form, the audio player, a handed file button and a level-up close the screen, and it comes back when they are gone (MutationObservers on the form, the player, the body and the list, and a focusout); blocked() also reads audioCtx.loading

features.mutationsGate: no native writes: every change is the page's own handler, run after the screen has closed
features.rollout: opt-in under Settings, Appearance: Native Library (beta), off by default

features.mutationsGate: delegates to existing web handlers; no native receipts yet (A14-A15 gap)

delegatedInteractions: every tab and room action stays in the live page

features.mutationsGate: acknowledged after shared web state saves; session-local dedupe only (not restart-safe, A14-A15 gap)

features.purpose: shared top/bottom bars and make-before-break hand-over between native tabs (A23, ADR 0002)
